blocks.text: Past Continuous + Past Simple: jarayon va uni bo'lgan voqea

Ko'pincha ikki o'tgan zamon bitta gapda birga keladi. Uzunroq harakat — fon — **Past Continuous** bilan, uning o'rtasida yuz bergan qisqa voqea esa **Past Simple** bilan aytiladi: I **was walking** home when it **started** to rain. O'zbekchada ham xuddi shunday tuzilma bor: «Uyga **ketayotganimda** yomg'ir **yog'a boshladi**». Ya'ni «**-yotganimda**» qismi — Past Continuous, asosiy fe'l «**-di**» — Past Simple.

Nega aynan shunday? Past Continuous harakat **voqea sodir bo'lganda allaqachon boshlangan va hali tugamagan** edi (dush qabul qilish telefon jiringlashidan oldin boshlangan). Past Simple harakat esa bir lahzada — «nuqta» kabi — bo'lib o'tdi. Uzun chiziqni qisqa nuqta kesib o'tadi.

**when** («-ganda», «-gan paytda») ko'pincha qisqa voqea oldida turadi: when the phone **rang**. **while** («-yotganda», «... paytida») esa uzun harakat oldida: while I **was cooking**. Gap qismlarining tartibi ma'noni o'zgartirmaydi: When the phone rang, I was having a shower = I was having a shower when the phone rang. when yoki while bilan boshlangan qism gap boshida kelsa, undan keyin vergul qo'yiladi.

items.text: When I **opened** the door, the cat **was sleeping** on the mat.

blocks.text: When ... we had / we were having: ma'no farqi

Ikkala qism ham **Past Simple** bo'lsa, harakatlar **ketma-ket**: avval biri, keyin ikkinchisi. When Aziz arrived, we **had** dinner — Aziz keldi, **keyin** ovqatlandik. Ikkinchi qism **Past Continuous** bo'lsa, u harakat **allaqachon davom etayotgan** edi: When Aziz arrived, we **were having** dinner — Aziz kelganda biz ovqatlanayotgan edik (ovqat undan oldin boshlangan). Bitta fe'l shakli butun ma'noni o'zgartiradi.

rows: When Aziz came, we **were having** dinner.
Aziz kelganda biz ovqatlanayotgan edik (ovqat allaqachon boshlangan).
When the film ended, I **went** to bed.
When the film ended, I **was sleeping**.
Film tugaganda men uxlab yotgan edim.

blocks.text: Ikki uzun harakat bir vaqtda parallel davom etgan bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham Past Continuous bo'ladi, ko'pincha **while** yoki **and** bilan. O'zbekchada: «Men idish yuvayotganimda, o'g'lim dars qilayotgan edi».

items.text: While I **was washing** the dishes, my son **was doing** his homework.
items.translation: Men idish **yuvayotganimda** o'g'lim **uy vazifasini qilayotgan edi**.

items.text: Mum **was cooking** and Dad **was cleaning** the car.
items.translation: Oyim ovqat **pishirayotgan edi**, dadam esa mashinani **tozalayotgan edi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I watched TV when the lights went out.» → I **was watching** TV when the lights went out. (televizor ko'rish chiroq o'chishidan oldin boshlangan); «While the phone rang, I was sleeping.» → **When** the phone rang, I was sleeping. (while — uzun harakat bilan); «When I was arrived ...» → When I **arrived** ... (was + V2 bo'lmaydi); «While I cooking ...» → While I **was cooking** ...

O'zbekcha qo'shimcha yordam beradi: «**-yotganimda**» (ketayotganimda, o'qiyotganimda) → **while / when** + was / were `-ing`; «**-ganimda**» (kelganimda, ko'rganimda) → **when** + Past Simple. Uzun harakat — chiziq, qisqa voqea — nuqta.
when bilan boshqa gaplar (When I get home, ...) — 98-dars; during va while farqi (during the film / while I was watching the film) — 105-dars. Past Continuous shakllari — 13-dars.

examples.title: I **was** ...**ing** when ... **happened**
examples.description: Uzun harakat (Past Continuous) + **when** + uni kesgan qisqa voqea (Past Simple). O'zbekchada: «-yotganimda ... -di».

sentences.text: I **was having** a shower when the phone **rang**.
We **were watching** a film when the lights **went** out.
Aziz **was crossing** the road when he **saw** his old teacher.
sentences.translation: Aziz ko'chani **kesib o'tayotganida** eski o'qituvchisini **ko'rib qoldi**.

sentences.text: The children **were playing** in the garden when it **started** to rain.
My mother **was cooking** dinner when she **burnt** her hand.
Emma **was sleeping** peacefully when the alarm **went** off.
Bekzod **was driving** to Samarkand when his car **broke** down.
Sorry, I **was talking** to my boss when you **called**.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, siz **qo'ng'iroq qilganingizda** boshlig'im bilan **gaplashayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **was walking** through the park when she **found** a little lost dog.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza park orqali **ketayotganida** adashib qolgan kichkina kuchukchani **topib oldi**.

sentences.text: We **were having** a picnic by the river when a strong wind **blew** our things away.
sentences.translation: Daryo bo'yida **piknik qilayotganimizda** kuchli shamol narsalarimizni **uchirib ketdi**.

examples.title: **When** + Past Simple, ... **was / were** -ing
examples.description: when qismi gap boshida — undan keyin vergul. Ma'no o'zgarmaydi: When I got home, my sister was cooking = My sister was cooking when I got home.

sentences.text: When I **got** home, my sister **was doing** her homework.
When the teacher **came** in, the students **were talking** loudly.
When we **arrived** at the station, it **was snowing**.
Yesterday, when I **saw** Tom, he **was waiting** for a bus.
Last night, when you **phoned**, I **was having** a bath.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun siz **qo'ng'iroq qilganingizda** vannada **cho'milayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: This morning, when I **woke up**, the sun **was shining**.
At the party, when Madina **walked** in, everybody **was dancing**.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatda Madina **kirib kelganida** hamma **raqs tushayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: In 2016, when I **met** my husband, he **was studying** in London.
sentences.translation: 2016-yilda turmush o'rtog'im bilan **tanishganimda** u Londonda **o'qiyotgan edi**.

sentences.text: My parents **were living** in Bukhara when I **was born**.
Ten minutes later, when the doctor **came**, Grandad **was feeling** much better.
sentences.translation: O'n daqiqadan keyin shifokor **kelganida** bobom o'zini ancha yaxshi **his qilayotgan edi**.

examples.title: **While** I **was** ...**ing**, ... **happened**
examples.description: **while** — uzun harakat oldida: «-yotganda», «... paytida». While I was cooking, I cut my finger = I cut my finger while I was cooking.

sentences.text: While I **was cooking**, I **cut** my finger.
While we **were waiting** for the bus, we **met** an old friend.
Somebody **stole** my bag while I **was sitting** in the café.
While Sarah **was living** in Manchester, she **learnt** to drive.
The baby **fell** asleep while his mother **was singing** to him.
Aziz **hurt** his leg while he **was playing** football.
James **visited** Samarkand and Bukhara while he **was travelling** in Asia.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Osiyo bo'ylab **sayohat qilganida** Samarqand va Buxoroni **ko'rdi**.

sentences.text: I **found** this old photo while I **was cleaning** my room.
My phone **rang** twice while we **were having** dinner.
sentences.translation: Biz kechki ovqat **qilayotganimizda** telefonim ikki marta **jiringladi**.

sentences.text: Madina **had** a great idea while she **was walking** home from work.
sentences.translation: Madina ishdan uyga **ketayotganida** xayoliga ajoyib fikr **keldi**.

examples.title: Two things at the same time: **while** ... **were** ...
examples.description: Ikki uzun harakat bir vaqtda parallel davom etgan — ikkalasi ham Past Continuous: While I was cooking, my husband was setting the table.

sentences.text: While I **was cooking**, my husband **was setting** the table.
Dad **was reading** the paper while Mum **was watering** the plants.
sentences.translation: Oyim gullarga **suv quyayotganida** dadam gazeta **o'qiyotgan edi**.

sentences.text: While the children **were sleeping**, we **were preparing** their presents.
Tom **was playing** the guitar and Emma **was singing**.
sentences.translation: Tom gitara **chalayotgan edi**, Emma esa **qo'shiq aytayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Some students **were writing**, while others **were looking** out of the window.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi talabalar **yozayotgan edi**, boshqalari esa derazadan **qarab o'tirgan edi**.

sentences.text: At the wedding the young people **were dancing** while the older guests **were talking** at the tables.
sentences.translation: To'yda yoshlar **raqs tushayotganida** kattalar stol atrofida **suhbatlashib o'tirishardi**.

sentences.text: I **wasn't listening** while the teacher **was explaining** the rule.
Bekzod **was working** on his laptop while his friends **were playing** cards.
It **was raining** outside, but inside we **were sitting** by a warm fire.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida yomg'ir **yog'ayotgan edi**, ichkarida esa biz iliq olov yonida **o'tirgan edik**.

sentences.text: While Dilnoza **was shopping** in the bazaar, her husband **was waiting** in the car.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bozorda **xarid qilayotganida** eri mashinada **kutib o'tirgan edi**.

examples.title: When Aziz **arrived**, we **had** / **were having** dinner
examples.description: Juft gaplar: Past Simple + Past Simple — ketma-ket (avval biri, keyin ikkinchisi); Past Simple + Past Continuous — ikkinchi harakat allaqachon davom etayotgan edi.

sentences.text: When Aziz **arrived**, we **had** dinner.
When Aziz **arrived**, we **were having** dinner.
I **turned off** the TV when the film **finished**.
I **was** already **sleeping** when the film **finished**.
Sarah **answered** the phone when it **rang**.
Sarah **was washing** her hair when the phone **rang**.
Madina **started** to cry when she **heard** the news.
Madina **was crying** when we **came** into the room.
When the teacher **asked** a question, Bekzod **put** up his hand.
Bekzod **was looking** out of the window when the teacher **asked** him a question.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi unga savol **berganida** Bekzod derazadan **qarab o'tirgan edi**.

examples.title: What **were** you **doing** when ...? Questions
examples.description: Savollarda ham ikki zamon birga: What were you doing when ...? Did you see ... while you were ...? How did you ...? — I ... while I was ...

sentences.text: What **were** you **doing** when the earthquake **started**?
Where **were** you **going** when I **saw** you yesterday?
**Was** it **raining** when you **left** the office?
How **did** you **break** your phone? — I **dropped** it while I **was running** for the bus.
**Did** you **see** the accident while you **were waiting** at the traffic lights?
What **was** Emma **wearing** when you **met** her at the airport?
sentences.translation: Emmani aeroportda **kutib olganingizda** u **nima kiygan edi**?

sentences.text: Who **were** you **talking** to when I **came** in?
Why **were** the children **laughing** when the teacher **walked** in?
So what **did** you **do** while you **were waiting** for the plane?
Aziz, **were** you **driving** when you **called** me? That's dangerous!
sentences.translation: Aziz, menga **qo'ng'iroq qilganingda** **mashina haydayotgan edingmi**? Bu xavfli-ku!

examples.title: A story: Bekzod's unlucky day
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: hikoyada fon va jarayon — Past Continuous, asosiy voqealar — Past Simple.

sentences.text: Last Monday **was** a really unlucky day for Bekzod.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dushanba Bekzod uchun juda **omadsiz kun bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: He **was having** breakfast when he **spilt** coffee on his white shirt.
sentences.translation: U **nonushta qilayotganida** oq ko'ylagiga qahva **to'kib yubordi**.

sentences.text: While he **was changing** his shirt, his bus **went** past the house.
sentences.translation: U ko'ylagini **almashtirayotganida** avtobusi uy yonidan **o'tib ketdi**.

sentences.text: So he **took** a taxi, but the traffic **was moving** very slowly.
sentences.translation: Shuning uchun u **taksiga o'tirdi**, lekin yo'lda mashinalar juda sekin **yurayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: When he finally **got** to the office, his colleagues **were** already **sitting** in the meeting.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat ofisga **yetib kelganida**, hamkasblari allaqachon yig'ilishda **o'tirishgan edi**.

sentences.text: The boss **was speaking**, and she **didn't look** very happy.
In the afternoon, while Bekzod **was working** on an important report, his computer suddenly **stopped**.
sentences.translation: Tushdan keyin Bekzod muhim hisobot ustida **ishlayotganida** kompyuteri birdan **o'chib qoldi**.

sentences.text: It **was raining** heavily when he **left** work in the evening.
He **was running** to the metro when he **slipped** and **fell** into a puddle.
sentences.translation: U metroga **yugurib ketayotganida** sirpanib, ko'lmakka **yiqilib tushdi**.

sentences.text: At home his wife **was waiting** for him with a hot dinner, and the day finally **got** better.
sentences.translation: Uyda esa xotini uni issiq ovqat bilan **kutib o'tirgan edi** va kun nihoyat **yaxshi tomonga o'zgardi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: How did you break your arm?
examples.description: Suhbatda voqeani aytib berish: I was skiing ... when a little boy appeared. Savol, javob va ikki zamon birga.

sentences.text: — Madina, what **happened** to your arm?
— I **broke** it last Saturday. I **was skiing** in the mountains.
sentences.translation: — O'tgan shanba **sindirib oldim**. Tog'da **chang'i uchayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! How **did** it **happen**?
— Well, I **was going** down a hill when a little boy **appeared** in front of me.
sentences.translation: — Tepalikdan **tushib kelayotganimda** oldimdan kichkina bola **chiqib qoldi**.

sentences.text: — And you **fell** while you **were trying** to stop?
— Exactly. I **turned** quickly, **lost** my balance and **hit** a tree.
sentences.translation: — Xuddi shunday. Tez **burildim**, muvozanatimni **yo'qotdim** va daraxtga **urilib ketdim**.

sentences.text: — That's terrible! **Were** you **skiing** alone?
— No, my brother **was skiing** behind me, and he **called** an ambulance.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, akam orqamda **uchib kelayotgan edi**, u **tez yordam chaqirdi**.

sentences.text: — Poor you! **Did** it **hurt** a lot?
— Yes, but while I **was lying** in the snow, I **was** only **thinking** about my exams next week!
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin qorda **yotganimda** faqat keyingi haftadagi imtihonlarim haqida **o'ylayotgan edim**!
